COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.497 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Yogesh Pacholia, learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
2. Mr. Pradeep Hariya, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. B.D. Pandey, learned counsel for 
respondent no.2-Commission. 
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. By means of this writ petition, the 
petitioner has challenged the application of 
reservation issued by the Commission in their 
recruitment process for the post of Assistant 
Teacher (LT Grade) (Mathematics) pursuant to 
the advertisement dated 13.10.2020.
6. The contention of the petitioner is that 
petitioners belong to open category candidate 
and participated as such in the selection 
process. Under the orphan quota, two posts
each were reserved in both Garhwal Mandal as 
well as in Kumaon Mandal. According to the 
petitioner, no candidate is available against that 
quota. As per Government Order dated 
22.05.2020, the said posts of orphan quota 
should be reverted back to the general category 
but the respondent-Commission has not done 
so and by inaction on the part of the 
respondent-Commission, petitioner may be 
deprived of his selection on the post of 
Assistant Teacher (L.T. Grade) (Mathematics).
7. Several opportunities have been given to 
learned counsel for respondent-Commission to 
file counter affidavit but till date no counter 
affidavit has been filed.
8. Respondent-Commission is given further 
six weeks’ time to file counter affidavit. 
9. List on 19.09.2024. 10. In the meantime, two posts of Assistant 
Teacher (L.T. Grade) (Mathematics) shall be 
kept vacant in Garhwal Mandal as well as in 
Kumaon Mandal. 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)

Mr. Yogesh Pacholia, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned S.C. for the State.
3. Mr. B.D. Pandey, learned counsel for the 
UKSSSC/respondent no.2.
4. Vide order dated 24.03.2025 State counsel was 
granted last opportunity to file counter affidavit 
within a period of four weeks.
Recall Application (IA No.6 of 2025)
5. Today the matter is listed on a recall 
application for recalling the order dated 24.03.2025 
and to take the counter affidavit filed by respondent 
no.2 on record.
6. Since no stop order is passed against 
respondent no.2, the recall application is 
misconceived and is accordingly rejected. 
7. Counter affidavit filed by respondent no.2 is 
taken on record.
Recall Application (IA No.7 of 2025)
8. Today the matter is listed on a recall 
application for recalling the order dated 24.03.2025 
and to take the counter affidavit filed by the State on 
record.
9. In view of the facts and circumstances stated in 
the recall application, recall application is allowed. 10. Counter affidavit filed by the State has already 
been taken on record.
11. Misc. Application (IA No.10 of 2026) has been 
filed by the petitioner seeking a direction to 
respondent no.2 to issue a waiting list.
12. Learned counsel for respondent no.2 is directed 
to file objection to the said application within two 
weeks.
13. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that 
the rejoinder affidavit to the counter affidavit of 
respondent no.2 has already been filed, however the 
petitioner does not want to file any rejoinder affidavit 
to the counter affidavit of the State.
14. List this case on 20.07.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
